node.title: PMA sigma-one paired-core source-layout normalization
node.statement: For a fixed received word U and every (k-1)-core C, interpolate Q_C=U|_C and evaluate phi_C=(U-Q_C)/L_C off C. Official maximal sigma-one source layouts are in bijection with cores whose phi_C fibers have signature (2,...,2,1); those fibers uniquely recover the background, petals, base polynomial, and labels, while any two planted anchors recover the core and chart. First-match Post is therefore the exact disjoint weighted sum over paired cores. No bound on that sum is claimed.
